title: Zephyr: IPv6 ICMPv6 complete
description: Implement ICMPv6 in Zephyr per project-LICHEN-u54o. Includes: Echo request/reply, destination unreachable. Pass shared test vectors.
close_reason: Completed Zephyr IPv6/ICMPv6 aggregate: RFC4443 echo/error handling and shared vectors validated (39/39 qemu_x86), DAD/IID/short-address host UBSan suites and Python vector parity green, scoped cppcheck green. Fixed normal boot address lifecycle so post-NET_DEVICE_INIT key loading transactionally reserves the canonical 02xx primary address, rolls it back on load failure, and retires the previous address on key rotation; focused ping_l2 regression asserts interface assignment. Modified production/test objects compile cleanly under strict Zephyr flags; full ping_l2 4.1 build is currently stopped by unrelated pre-existing lora_loopback DT unused-symbol errors.
